threat_event: Ransomware spreads through shared IT services and halts production at all plants and the Electric Utility storm logistics
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One identity domain, one GEPS, and shared file servers connect all divisions; P8 legacy domain trust; GEPS full restore untested
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G1; SYS-G4 GEPS; SYS-G6; SYS-M1 and SYS-M2 at P8
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-046, G-059); SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05; C-CRITICAL-MFG-R01 (proposed; readiness only)
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR; PAM; immutable backups; OT DMZs at P1 to P7
treatment_plan: Remove the P8 domain trust; P8 behind an OT DMZ; full GEPS restore test; cross-division ransomware tabletop (P08)

threat_event: GEPS integration hub compromise or failed recovery stops work order release to all 8 plants beyond the 48-hour MES buffer
threat_source: Cybercriminal or insider using hub service accounts; recovery failure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 hub service accounts with standing write access to all plant MES and static keys; APS and hub never restored in a test
regulatory_driver: None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-035, G-060)
existing_controls: Hub behind the landing-zone hub; EDR on hub servers; daily immutable backups
treatment_plan: One service account per plant with vaulted rotating keys; hub logs to the SIEM; full restore test in provider B

threat_event: A cross-division incident misses one or more regulator, customer, or investor notice deadlines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Group notification matrix drafted 2026-06 and never exercised; clocks range from 1 hour (DOE-417) to 4 business days after materiality (Form 8-K)
affected_asset_or_process: Group incident response; division notice owners
regulatory_driver: Utility addendum sec. 1 (CIP-013-2 R1.2.1 flow-down) (P03 G-091); N22-R01 (CIP-008-6 R4); SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05
existing_controls: Group IR plan v5; disclosure committee charter; TCC reporting binder
treatment_plan: Adopt the multi-regulator matrix (P08); cross-division tabletop by 2026-12-15

threat_event: Tampered TMU firmware signed with a stolen key is distributed to utility substations, including the affiliate
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Signing key in a software keystore on a build server in the group data center; build servers in the corporate domain
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-M5 firmware pipeline; TMUs at about 700 utilities
regulatory_driver: Utility addendum sec. 5 (CIP-013-2 R1.2.5 flow-down) (P03 G-095); None binding; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-068)
existing_controls: Hashes published with each release; two-person review on release branches; PSIRT
treatment_plan: Move signing to a hardware security module with split control; isolate build servers; reproducible builds for the top 3 firmware lines

threat_event: Affiliate vendor arrangements without security terms cause Electric Utility CIP noncompliance or exposure of TCC information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2019 supply and 2020 services agreements have no security schedules; TCC design documents on SYS-S1 outside the utility CIP-011-3 program
regulatory_driver: N22-R01 (CIP-011-3 R1; CIP-013-2 R1); N54-R04 (FAR 52.204-21) not affected
existing_controls: Utility CIP-013-2 plan treats both affiliates as vendors; CIP-004-7 access program
treatment_plan: Security schedules in both intercompany agreements; move TCC BCSI to a restricted repository; affiliate vendor assessments

threat_event: AI models steer production and storm allocation without validation or a documented allocation rule
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AI-001 and AI-002 went live before the Group AI Standard; no independent validation; storm-reserve allocation rule not written
regulatory_driver: None binding; Group AI Standard (P10); CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-063)
existing_controls: Planners review the forecast; maintenance planners decide work orders
treatment_plan: Independent validation; drift monitoring; written storm allocation rule approved by the AI council and counsel (P10)

threat_event: An attacker moves from the acquired plant into corporate identity through the legacy domain trust
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two-way trust between the P8 legacy domain and the corporate domain; P8 servers without EDR
existing_controls: SOC monitoring of corporate domain controllers
treatment_plan: Break the trust; migrate P8 users to SYS-G1; EDR on all P8 servers

threat_event: Electric Utility potential CIP violations lead to penalties and enforcement
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CIP-003-9 Attachment 1 Section 6.3 detection at 22 of 58 substations; CIP-012-2 Parts 1.2 and 1.3 missing
existing_controls: CIP Senior Manager; NERC compliance director; mitigation plans
treatment_plan: Self-report to SERC by 2026-09-30 with mitigation plans (P03); complete detection and the CIP-012-2 plan

threat_event: Data theft from legacy group file servers (HR exports with Social Security numbers; Grid Engineering archives with client CEII)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy on-premises file servers with broad share permissions; HR exports kept beyond retention
regulatory_driver: State breach laws (Fla. Stat. 501.171 worked example) (P03 G-102); client CEII terms
treatment_plan: Purge HR exports; migrate archives to SYS-S1 restricted folders; retire the file servers

threat_event: Undocumented inheritance and drifted standards at Grid Engineering hide control failures
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Grid Engineering inheritance not documented; 2023 standards conflict with group policy (log retention, personal cloud storage)
affected_asset_or_process: Grid Engineering control environment; SOC 2 report
treatment_plan: Inheritance matrix; re-issued division supplement; annual attestation
owner: Grid Engineering security and compliance lead

threat_event: Critical supplier compromise or outage (ERP vendor, EDI provider, cloud provider, TMU contract manufacturer)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single ERP vendor and EDI provider; one TMU contract manufacturer
existing_controls: Annual tier 1 supplier reviews; 24-hour notice terms in ERP and EDI contracts
treatment_plan: Continuous monitoring of tier 1 suppliers; second source qualification for TMU boards

threat_event: Late or inaccurate SEC disclosure of a material cybersecurity incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Materiality factors for a production-stopping incident not pre-agreed; disclosure committee never exercised with plant data
treatment_plan: Materiality worksheet with production loss and customer impact factors; include in the 2026-12 tabletop

threat_event: Hurricane disables the Florida plants and the group data center during storm season
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: P1, P2, and the group data center (firmware build servers, legacy file servers) are in Florida
existing_controls: Generators; cloud hosting for GEPS and FMS in two providers
treatment_plan: Move build servers to cloud with HSM signing; storm transfer plan for P1 and P2 orders to P4 and P5

threat_event: Covered telecommunications equipment in use makes the group ineligible for federal awards
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Covered cameras found at P8 during integration; acquisition due diligence did not check covered equipment
affected_asset_or_process: Physical security systems; federal contracts in two divisions
existing_controls: Reported to contracting officers within 1 business day; purchasing check since 2026-07
treatment_plan: Replace the 9 P8 cameras; covered-equipment check in acquisition due diligence

threat_event: Insider abuses cross-division GEPS access to divert spare transformers or storm stock
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 11 users hold both storm stock issue and spare release roles
existing_controls: Quarterly certification; SOX segregation of duties for finance roles
treatment_plan: Remove the conflicting role pairs; add the rule to the SoD rule set

threat_event: Loss of key OT security and NERC compliance staff
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Small specialist teams (8 OT security, 6 NERC compliance)
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low by the Group CISO; review each year
